whatWasBuilt.summary: Reversed the invariant in packages/engine-core/src/parcel-record/ingest-existing.ts so a genuine CAD join miss (no cad_property row for that county+propId across every tax year CAD_ROWS_SQL observed) emits absent-verified instead of staying unaccounted forever, per the operator ruling.
files: packages/engine-core/src/parcel-record/cell-state.ts: added CadJoinMissBasis (source/countyFips/propId/vintage, deliberately no taxYear -- there is no matched row to read one from), widened ScalarAbsentVerifiedCell.basis to include it alongside the existing CadNullVerifiedBasis.

packages/engine-core/src/parcel-record/ingest-existing.ts: added cadJoinMissVerified + applyCadJoinMiss (mirrors applyCadScalar's stampAbsent set, never a value), wired into ingestCadOntoRecords's !cad branch (previously `if (!cad) continue`).

packages/engine-core/src/parcel-record/__tests__/parcel-record.test.ts: rewrote the falsifier test '(b) join miss stays unaccounted...' to assert absent-verified with the join-miss basis, keeping its original core protection intact (a value under a different CAD key must never leak onto the join-missed record) -- and extended the structural-scoping test to also check the two new functions aren't exported.
whatWasBuilt.fieldsDeliberatelyExcluded: apn (never had an absent path even for a matched row's own null field -- would just echo record.propId, not a real CAD confirmation); landUseSource/acreageMethod (derived metadata only ever stamped alongside a real value, same as the existing matched-null behavior).

reversalCriteriaCheck.question: Does a real population of parcel_record rows get its identity from something other than cad_property (e.g. geometry-only), where a join miss would mean a key-format mismatch rather than a genuine absence?
reversalCriteriaCheck.finding: No such population found. Two independent sources agree the parcel universe's identity is cad_property-sourced: packages/engine-core/scripts/prove-parcel-record-county.mjs builds its record set via `SELECT DISTINCT ON (prop_id) ... FROM cad_property`, joining txgio_parcel only for incorporation containment, never for identity; and the B3-GEOMGAP mission close (_inbox/2026-09-01_parcel-b3-geomgap_close.json) independently confirms the program's parcel-universe count is CAD-account-based, with txgio_parcel geometry sometimes missing FOR a CAD account (vintage lag, undivided-interest fanning) -- the reverse direction, not a CAD-absent geometry-sourced parcel. The R-prefix undivided-interest case (test (b2), 'live Williamson shape') is a same-source key variant within cad_property itself and is already a matched row, not a join miss -- unaffected by this change.
reversalCriteriaCheck.conclusion: Safe to apply the reversal uniformly. No population-scoped guard needed.
